Fedele alla visione "Creiamo l'innovazione per migliorare la vita delle persone", le aziende Hamilton forniscono soluzioni per l'industria sanitaria dal 1950. Siamo un pioniere innovativo in termini di ventilatori, pipettaggio automatizzato e stoccaggio di campioni e lo sviluppo di sensori di processo.

Il business unit Operations produce parti per tutte le aziende Hamilton da parti stampate ad iniezione a punte pipette per la movimentazione di liquidi in parti metalliche e plastiche. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di produrre più parti possibile in-house. In questo modo, rimaniamo agili, indipendenti ed efficienti.

Può farlo?

- Funzionamento e monitoraggio degli impianti di produzione verso impianti di stampaggio ad iniezione, automazione e confezionamento

- Rilevamento, analisi e risoluzione di semplici difetti e azione immediata appropriata

- Relazione e documentazione degli incidenti e della cooperazione con la manutenzione in caso di problemi tecnici

- Attuazione dei controlli di qualità e della documentazione

- Documentazione dei dati di produzione e degli stati degli impianti

- Garantire il rispetto delle norme di sicurezza, igiene e qualità

Questo è ciò che porti:

- Formazione professionale completa in una professione tecnica o industriale o esperienza professionale comparabile

- Esperienza come, operatore di impianti, operatore di macchine o dipendente di produzione

- Comprensione tecnica e gestione sicura dei sistemi di controllo dei processi e delle strutture produttive

- Campo di lavoro indipendente, attento e responsabile

- Lavoro di squadra, affidabilità e assertività

- Durevole e flessibile

- Prontezza al lavoro in 3 - funzionamento a turni

True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors.

The Operations business unit produces parts for all Hamilton companies from injection moulded parts to pipette tips for liquid handling to metal and plastic parts. Our goal is to produce as many parts as possible in-house. In this way, we remain agile, independent and efficient.

You can do that :

- Operation and monitoring of production plants towards injection moulding, automation and packaging plants

- Detecting, analysing and resolving simple faults and taking appropriate immediate action

- Reporting and documentation of incidents and cooperation with maintenance in the event of technical problems

- Implementation of quality controls and documentation

- Documentation of production data and plant states

- Ensuring compliance with safety, hygiene and quality rules

This is what you bring :

- Completed vocational training in a technical or industrial profession or comparable professional experience

- Experience as, plant operator, machine operator or production employee

- Technical understanding and safe handling of process control systems and production facilities

- Independent, careful and responsible work scope

- Teamwork, reliability and assertiveness

- Durable and flexible

- Readiness to work in 3 - shift operation

La Business Unit Process Analytics sviluppa, produce e vende tecnologie di misura di processo all'avanguardia per i clienti in biofarmaci, chimica e birrerie. Il nostro portafoglio di prodotti comprende sensori per parametri di processo critici come pH, ossigeno o sensori per la misura della densità cellulare, come ad esempio sono estremamente importanti nei processi biologici e unici con la loro tecnologia innovativa in tutto il mondo. Stai dirigendo un team di progetto interdisciplinare di scienziati:inside, tecnici:inside e specialista del prodotto. - Con il supporto del vostro team, incontrerete solide decisioni tecniche per il vostro progetto. - Sei responsabile di date, risorse e budget all'interno dei tuoi progetti. - Coordinate sia il vostro team di progetto interno che la collaborazione con i partner di sviluppo esterni. - Garantisci una comunicazione proattiva e trasparente con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Lei presenta regolarmente i progressi del progetto e fornisce chiarezza su obiettivi, rischi e passi successivi. - Se avete bisogno, sarete anche in grado di lavorare nello sviluppo, come i principi di misura, l'elettronica, la meccanica o il firmware. Ce poste dirige une équipe de comptables et joue un rôle clé dans l'amélioration continue des processus de clôture, des systèmes et des contrôles, assurant une information financière de haute qualité conforme aux exigences législatives et organisationnelles. ## Principales responsabilités - Diriger et développer une équipe de comptables GL, y compris l'embauche, l'encadrement, la gestion du rendement et la promotion du perfectionnement professionnel continu - S'assurer de l'exécution de toutes les activités du grand livre général de haute qualité, y compris les écritures de journaux, les comptes d'exercice, les rapprochements et les transactions interentreprises, en mettant fortement l'accent sur l'exactitude, l'exhaustivité et la rapidité - Prendre l'entière responsabilité des processus de clôture mensuels et annuels, assurer l'exécution efficace, bien contrôlée et en temps opportun dans toutes les entités - Gérer et superviser le processus de regroupement des groupes, assurer la préparation exacte et en temps opportun des états financiers consolidés conformément aux normes comptables applicables - Examiner et valider les états financiers et les extrants de regroupement, s'assurer de la conformité aux exigences législatives locales et aux politiques comptables de groupe - Établir, surveiller et améliorer continuellement les normes de rapprochement et de clôture, s'assurer que les écarts sont identifiés et résolus de façon proactive - Agir comme point de contact principal pour les audits internes et externes, assurer la documentation de haute qualité, les processus d'audit et le règlement en temps des constatations - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes

descriptionByLocale.en: Description - In line with the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", the Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. - We are an innovative pioneer in the fields of ventilation devices, automated pipetting and storage of samples, as well as the development of process sensors. - As part of the Shared Services (SHS) business unit of Hamilton Bonaduz AG, this department assumes central responsibilities for the Hamilton companies. - Teams in HR, ICT, Corporate Communication, Facilities and Finance ensure that processes run smoothly and employees worldwide are optimally supported. ## Responsibilities - Function as the central contact person for all health and safety issues in the company – in close exchange with internal departments and external partners, authorities and expert bodies - Independent implementation of EKAS guideline 6508 including continuous monitoring, further development and ensuring compliance - Independent advice to managers and employees on all matters of occupational safety and health protection – your technical expertise is actively requested and integrated into decision-making processes - Comprehensive planning, coordination and implementation of all health and safety-related activities – structured, proactive and on time - Independent analysis of accident and incident statistics, root cause analysis and development and implementation of effective preventive measures to sustainably strengthen the safety culture - Organization, execution and follow-up of internal audits, inspections and controls in the field of occupational safety – including derivation, prioritization and tracking of improvement measures - Preparation of sound risk and hazard analyses for workplaces, equipment and hazardous substances taking into account current legal, regulatory and company requirements - Continuous independent further development of the safety standard through systematic measures management with a clear focus on prevention and effectiveness - Maintenance, further development and quality assurance of safety-related documentation – structured, traceable and audit-proof - Monitoring the correct storage and handling of hazardous substances in accordance with legal requirements ## Requirements - Completed vocational training in an industrial environment and further education in the field of occupational safety and health protection (ASGS) - Professional examination as ASGS specialist with Swiss federal certificate or further education as EKAS safety engineer - Several years of professional experience as a safety officer (SiBe) in a complex industrial environment - Very independent, responsible and structured way of working with high personal initiative and decision-making ability - Broad and in-depth knowledge of occupational safety, health protection, prevention and relevant legal and regulatory requirements - Pronounced leadership qualities ## What we offer - The opportunity to assume central responsibilities for the Hamilton companies as part of the Shared Services (SHS) business unit of Hamilton Bonaduz AG - Comprehensive further education and development in the field of occupational safety and health protection - An independent and responsible way of working with high personal initiative and decision-making ability - A wide range of challenges and opportunities for development and improvement of the safety culture ## Contact - If you are interested in this challenge, please send your application to [Kontaktinformationen]
